message.content:
Belts of textile material fall under HTSUS 6217.10 (other made up clothing accessories; accessories). Belts are generally classified in 4203.30 if leather or composition leather, but this belt has an outer layer of polyester webbing and an inner layer of polyurethane (plastic), so the textile material gives it its character.

In similar CBP rulings for textile belts, the classification was 6217.10.9530 (belts, of man-made fibers) or 6217.10.9540 (other). The older "other" subheading 6217.10.95 breaks into: 6217.10.9510 (cotton), 6217.10.9520 (wool or fine animal hair), 6217.10.9530 (man-made fibers), 6217.10.9540 (other).

The alternative, HTSUS 3926.90 for plastic belts, doesn't apply, since the textile is the outer layer and a webbing belt is typically 6217. Note that 6217.10.85 covers "other: containing 70% or more by weight of silk or silk waste" and similar, so it doesn't apply either.

Belts are known to be classified in 6217.10.95; the sub-subheading for man-made fibers is 6217.10.9530.

